meta.note: per-event journey data for the Atlas (889 loud, 606 medium, 555 faint)

waveform.prov: real: few GenerateEMRIWaveform(waveform_class='Pn5AAKWaveform'), the production wave generator, called directly (dt=10 s, T=48 h), first 48 h, source-frame h_plus (pre-TDI)
waveform.note: Same initial conditions as the full production run -> this is exactly the first 48 hours of that trajectory, not a separate short run.

ftrack.prov: real: few EMRIInspiral(func=PN5) trajectory, f_phi = d(Phi_phi)/dt / (2 pi) via cubic-spline derivative, dominant harmonic reported as 2*f_phi

spectrum.prov: real: Welch ASD (scipy.signal.welch) of the 48-hour few snapshot, hc = sqrt(f*S_h)

ball.method: chord distance <= radius_full_rad (ch06_fisher.json, production BallTree metric) AND redshift inside z_window, over the production stellar-BH-mass-pruned ecliptic-frame patch
ball.prov: real: reduced catalogue count (gen_ch06.py sky-patch pipeline, reused)

geolike.prov: toy: geometric reconstruction, lnL(h) = log INT N(d_L(z;h); d_L_meas, sigma_eff) * w(z) dz over z_window, w(z) the same comoving-volume prior as atlas_curves.json's zkernel section; sigma_eff includes the host photo-z term (sigma_z=0.035, propagated through dd_L/dz at h=0.73) because this event is in-catalogue

kernelz.prov: real: bayesian_statistics host-z volume kernel shape, recentered on this event's own z_window (same math as atlas_curves.json's zkernel)
